content:
[C] high | full window below the table: roughly 65% of the viewport is a dead empty gray zone while all content is crushed into the top ~200px, reading as an unfinished debug layout
[S] high | toolbar row: the Search button is far-right and visually disconnected from the search input on the far-left, breaking the input/action pairing
[H] med | toolbar: Search is a heavy dark filled button while the primary action "Sync now" is a light secondary button — prominence is inverted
[H] med | table header row: column labels are rendered in tiny faint ALL-CAPS gray that is nearly unreadable and inconsistent with the row text weight
[S] med | table columns: CONVERSATIONS and LAST CONTACT values are left-aligned against ambiguous column starts, leaving large uneven dead gaps between EMAIL and the right-side Open buttons
[H] med | count label "4 customers (of 4)": metadata text is tiny, gray, and floats unanchored next to Sync now with no grouping
[C] low | table rows: the "Open" buttons are floating buttons per row with no row hover state or borders, making the table read as a raw widget list
[C] low | top-left corner: black window edge artifact at the very top-left corner looks like an unpainted region border
[H] low | page title "Customers": title is small and weak, giving no header hierarchy versus the table content

VERDICT: unprofessional — mostly empty canvas, disconnected controls, inverted action hierarchy, and a table that reads like a debug listing rather than a product screen.
